title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image from the context menu
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned image action and its two named availability policies. The documented policy paths, registry settings and scope are supported; image-specific defaults, licensing and policy interactions remain explicitly unresolved.
